text: Motor memory consolidation may be influenced by offline application of non-invasive brain stimulation to the primary motor cortex (M1). One potential underlying mechanism involves changes in oscillatory neuronal activity within the premotor and primary motor cortices, as well as their interaction.
source_label: Absence of evidence for post-training tDCS effects on motor memory consolidation and premotor–primary motor cortex interaction: a resting-state EEG study
